title: chore: release packages
body:
This PR was opened by the [Changesets release](https://github.com/changesets/action) GitHub action. When you're ready to do a release, you can merge this and publish to npm yourself or [setup this action to publish automatically](https://github.com/changesets/action#with-publishing). If you're not ready to do a release yet, that's fine, whenever you add more changesets to main, this PR will be updated.


# Releases
## @object-ui/console@18.1.1

### Patch Changes

- cd70b78: Clause-②: no
  Metadata-protocol: none
  
  One react line: every manifest that pins `react` / `react-dom` now pins 19.3.0, and every `@types/react` / `@types/react-dom` pin is 19.3.0, matching the root `pnpm.overrides`. The objectstack monorepo's `@objectstack/client-react` requires react `^19.3.0`, and a second `@types/react` copy broke `@object-ui/plugin-view`'s declaration build in the merged tree. The CLI's scaffold (`REACT_RANGE` and the shared dev-dependency map in `scaffold-dependencies.ts`) quotes the same pins, as its anchor test requires.
- @object-ui/sdui-parser@18.1.1
